sources.entry: Seatsurfing - Webbased app to book seats, desks and rooms for offices. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: Seatsurfing is a self-hostable web application that lets organization employees book seats, desks and rooms in an office.
summary.what_it_does: The repository contains the backend for Seatsurfing, including a REST API server written in Go. It also includes a User Self-Service Booking Web Interface, built as a Progressive Web Application that can be installed on mobile devices, and a separate Admin Web Interface. Both web frontends are TypeScript/React and share common TypeScript files. The Docker setup runs the server alongside a PostgreSQL database, with the Booking UI at /ui/search/ and the Admin UI at /ui/admin/. The README also mentions a Kubernetes deployment guide and an optional Plus Plugin for additional functionality, and lists Microsoft Teams and Atlassian Confluence (cloud-only) as integrations.
use_cases: let staff find and reserve workspace
how_to_run: Create a docker-compose.yml with the server (image ghcr.io/seatsurfing/backend) and a postgres:18 database service, as shown in the README
Set POSTGRES_URL, CRYPT_KEY, PUBLIC_SCHEME and PUBLIC_PORT environment variables on the server service
Open :8080/ui/admin/ and log in with the default admin account admin@seatsurfing.local, or set INIT_ORG_USER and INIT_ORG_PASS first
Refer to the Kubernetes documentation for cluster deployments
Set LISTEN_ADDR to :: for IPv6-only Docker/Podman environments if needed
notable: Booking UI is a installable Progressive Web Application for mobile devices
Separate admin web interface alongside the user booking interface
Docker images published for amd64 and arm64
Optional Plus Plugin for extra self-hosted functionality
Hosted SaaS version also offered by the maintainers
caveats: The default admin credentials are published in the README, so they should be changed via INIT_ORG_USER and INIT_ORG_PASS
Some functionality is reserved for the paid Plus Plugin or Professional plan
keywords: open source alternative to room booking software
share office desks with my team
book a desk for hybrid work
